args.body: Under a valid lease, continue the selected supplier test using any committed original notice or supplier evidence first. If the queued original-award-record-screen.json commits, use it only to locate full OCDS fields and inspect their context. An empty screen establishes only that the local scan found no match. Within the existing supplier-page allowance, verify the supplier's explicit current invitation for paid work and its response route. If the award and invitation fit, execute the passing and failing controls tied to the quoted obligation and save the copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise record the exact gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.
